supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: moderate extension visible beyond the outer eye corners, contributing to a wide upper facial silhouette

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: marked pixel intensity contrast between a light-toned (low melanin) muzzle and chin region against dark-toned (high melanin) periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: moderate 2D vertical thickness visible on the lower lip in a neutral pose

other_distinctive_markers: presence of sparse, light-colored (white) hairs localized on the lower chin area
